host.description: IBM host hostname or IP address

port.description: TCP port to connect to (23 for telnet, 992 for tn3270e+ssl)

lu_name.description: Logon Unit (LU) name for TN3270E SNA mode

tls.description: TLS configuration (set to {enabled: true} to enable TLS; individual certs optional)

tls.enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for the connection

tls.ca_cert.description: Path to CA certificate for verifying server

tls.client_cert.description: Path to client certificate for mutual TLS (optional)

tls.client_key.description: Path to client private key for mutual TLS (optional)

session_options.description: List of command-line options to pass to b3270 (without '-' prefix)
